text: 21 In the Classroom 2.3 Raj : Didi, what is this picture about? Nima : This is the picture of a classroom. Raj : Who is she? Nima : She is a teacher. Raj : What is this? Nima : It is a chart showing flowers. Raj : What is this? Nima : This is a blackboard. Raj : Didi, I want to go to school. Nima : Yes, Raj. You will go to school next year. 2.
